description: Per-supplier GL auto-coding (spec 06): default expense account, cost center, purchase-tax template, payment terms, and accounting dimensions layered ON TOP of native Party Account / Supplier.payment_terms / tax_category. One row per Supplier (autoname field:supplier, unique). Single-company pilot scope (D1).

fields.description: Profile-level override of the native Supplier.payment_terms (native remains the base).
fields.label: Default Payment Terms Template

fields.description: Layer-1 expense account written onto the PI item row.
fields.label: Default Expense Account

fields.description: The supplier's assigned cost center — the lowest-priority cost-center inference signal.
fields.label: Default Cost Center

fields.description: Layer-1 tax template; written to the PI header taxes_and_charges.
fields.label: Default Purchase Tax Template

fields.description: Thin (dimension, value) pairs applied to the PI item row when the dimension's custom field exists on the site.
fields.label: Default Accounting Dimensions

fields.description: Per-supplier overrides for the validation gates (spec 08). Blank = fall through to AP Closed Loop Settings.
fields.label: Validation Gate Overrides

fields.description: Override of the 3WM qty tolerance % for this supplier (blank = settings).
fields.label: Qty Tolerance % (override)

fields.description: Override of the 3WM amount tolerance % for this supplier (blank = settings).
fields.label: Amount Tolerance % (override)

fields.description: Override of the anomaly multiple for this supplier (e.g. a high-variance vendor). Blank = settings.
fields.label: Anomaly Multiple (override)

fields.description: Override of the anomaly sigma for this supplier. Blank = settings.
fields.label: Anomaly Sigma (override)

fields.description: Override of the anomaly min-sample for this supplier. Blank = settings.
fields.label: Anomaly Min Sample (override)

name: AP Supplier Coding Profile
